title: Test Connection
description: As a user connecting to PostgreSQL, I want the backend to test my connection credentials so that I know immediately if the connection is valid.
acceptanceCriteria: Given connection parameters are provided, when the frontend calls the test-connection endpoint, then the backend attempts a connection to PostgreSQL 14+ and returns success or a descriptive error
